The '''Chekkoo Province''' was a region on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. The [[Chekkoo Enclave/Legends|Chekkoo Enclave]] was located here.

==Description==
The province was hidden away in the deepest jungle of the eastern [[Betu/Legends|Betu]] continent. Jungle lowlands, known as the [[Ekloska forest]]s, and a portion of the [[Ekloska Hills]] provided formidable terrain for anyone traveling in the region. The headwaters of the [[Teonsqua River]] could also be found here, though the river quickly turned into a vast swampland at the province's southern edge.<ref name="planguid">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

The [[Chekkoo clan/Legends|Chekkoo]] were fiercely protective of their lands. Regular patrols could be found both on foot and in the air. Poor as the Chekkoo were, they still maintained the defenses of a small army. Trespassers were hunted down as soon as they were discovered.<ref name="planguid" /> Not only the Chekkoo, but [[Chattza clan/Legends|Chattza]] [[Protector (Rin'na)|Protectors]] controlled traffic and made thorough checks for illegal goods.<ref name="problems">{{WEGCite|story=Provincial Problems|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref>

==History==
Chekkoo was one of the most powerful provinces of Betu. After centuries of struggle and warfare the [[Chekkoo clan/Legends|Chekkoo clan]] became cautious, if not suspicious and xenophobic. They shared the land with a few smaller clans' enclaves (including the closest, [[Adebsu clan]] and [[Intamm clan]]) and were allies. Each clan had autonomous control of its enclave, though the Chekkoo, as the dominant clan, claimed final judgment for the lands of the province.<ref name="planguid" />

When [[Navik/Legends|Navik the Red]] came to power, he rerouted the trade lanes, cutting off supply shipments to the Province, effectively making the once-powerful Chekkoo province, and its dominant clan, one of the poorest on Rodia. The inhabitants of the Province took to hiring [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] to bring supplies to their impoverished region.<ref name="planguid" /> Chekkoo Protectors, even though not daring to confront the Chattza directly, they would use tricks and traps against them to aid expected smugglers to enter safely their province.<ref name="problems" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], smugglers attempted to enter the provice, bringing [[Power fence generator/Legends|power fence generators]]; they managed to evade the Chattza checkpoints and met a Chekkoo contingent at a rendezvous point. After bartaining the generators's price, the hunters evaluated the smugglers they would hire.<ref name="problems" />
